sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 370. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 8 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 10 seconds for one time only. [Demerit]

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Twilight for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Only [7th Squad Commander] Kyouka Uzen can be used as Unlocking Potential material
